sections.content:

Equity theme
The dominant driver for equities today is a severe tech-led sell-off fueled by Nvidia's regulatory and legal warnings ahead of its earnings report, combined with broader macro headwinds. Investors are also digesting geopolitical developments including the Crimea bridge attack and rising sovereign debt yields with the US 10Y at 5.121 percent.

Leaders & laggards
Mega caps are showing uniform weakness with 0 of 8 higher, led by Nvidia dropping 4.12 percent to 156.14 and Alphabet losing 4.07 percent to 283.72, while Apple proved relatively resilient with a modest 0.98 percent decline to 352.78. Semis SOXX slumped 5.41 percent to 141.22, and the Nasdaq 100 underperformed major indices with a 2.67 percent drop to 27,197.

Europe & Asia
European indices traded firmly in the red with the DAX down 0.88 percent to 26,366 and Euro Stoxx 50 falling 0.91 percent to 6,290.73 amid banking sector pressure. Asian markets also closed lower, led by KOSPI dropping 2.
